name: Marukubo Hidenoshin
source:
Founder of Kanade Sakura Academy and serves as its principal.

With a cheerful personality, he maintains (superficially) good relationships with students regardless of gender. 

However, unsavory rumors circulate among some female students... A lecherous old man who loves breasts.
